items.question_text: You are developing a new deep learning model that predicts a customer's likelihood to buy on your ecommerce site. After running an evaluation of the model against both the original training data and new test data, you find that your model is overfitting the data. You want to improve the accuracy of the model when predicting new data. What should you do?
items.solution_text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns noise or irrelevant patterns in the training data, often due to excessive complexity relative to the amount of data. Decreasing the number of input features reduces this complexity (feature selection), helping prevent the model from fitting to noise. Simultaneously, increasing the size of the training dataset provides more examples for the model to learn general patterns rather than memorizing specific instances, thereby improving accuracy on new, unseen data.

choices.text: Increase the size of the training dataset, and increase the number of input features.
Increase the size of the training dataset, and decrease the number of input features.
Reduce the size of the training dataset, and increase the number of input features.
Reduce the size of the training dataset, and decrease the number of input features.

items.question_text:
You are implementing a chatbot to help an online retailer streamline their customer service. The chatbot must be able to respond to both text and voice inquiries.
You are looking for a low-code or no-cade option, and you want to be able to easily train the chatbot to provide answers to keywords. What should you do?
items.solution_text: Dialogflow is a low-code conversational AI platform that natively handles both text and voice inputs through integrated speech-to-text and text-to-speech APIs, eliminating the need for custom application code. Defining intents allows you to map keywords and user queries to specific responses, directly satisfying the requirement to train the chatbot on common inquiries.

choices.text: Use the Cloud Speech-to-Text API to build a Python application in App Engine.
Use the Cloud Speech-to-Text API to build a Python application in a Compute Engine instance.
Use Dialogflow for simple queries and the Cloud Speech-to-Text API for complex queries.
Use Dialogflow to implement the chatbot, defining the intents based on the most common queries collected.

items.question_text:
An aerospace company uses a proprietary data format to store its flight data. You need to connect this new data source to BigQuery and stream the data into
BigQuery. You want to efficiently import the data into BigQuery while consuming as few resources as possible. What should you do?
items.solution_text:
Option D is correct because Dataflow provides managed, auto-scaling stream processing essential for efficient ingestion with minimal resource waste.
Since the source is a proprietary format, a custom Apache Beam connector is required to parse it before streaming into BigQuery in an optimized columnar-friendly format like Avro.
Options A and C use batch or manual-cluster approaches that lack real-time efficiency, while Option B defers necessary transformations, violating the requirement for efficient import.

choices.text: Write a shell script that triggers a Cloud Function that performs periodic ETL batch jobs on the new data source.
Use a standard Dataflow pipeline to store the raw data in BigQuery, and then transform the format later when the data is used.
Use Apache Hive to write a Dataproc job that streams the data into BigQuery in CSV format.
Use an Apache Beam custom connector to write a Dataflow pipeline that streams the data into BigQuery in Avro format.

items.question_text: An online brokerage company requires a high volume trade processing architecture. You need to create a secure queuing system that triggers jobs. The jobs will run in Google Cloud and call the company's Python API to execute trades. You need to efficiently implement a solution. What should you do?
items.solution_text:
Cloud Functions triggered by Pub/Sub push subscriptions provide a serverless, highly scalable solution ideal for high-volume trade processing.
They eliminate the need to manage underlying infrastructure (like Compute Engine or Cloud Composer), ensuring efficient cost optimization and automatic scaling during traffic spikes.

choices.text: Use a Pub/Sub push subscription to trigger a Cloud Function to pass the data to the Python API.
Write an application hosted on a Compute Engine instance that makes a push subscription to the Pub/Sub topic.
Write an application that makes a queue in a NoSQL database.
Use Cloud Composer to subscribe to a Pub/Sub topic and call the Python API.

items.question_text: Your company wants to be able to retrieve large result sets of medical information from your current system, which has over 10 TBs in the database, and store the data in new tables for further query. The database must have a low-maintenance architecture and be accessible via SQL. You need to implement a cost-effective solution that can support data analytics for large result sets. What should you do?
items.solution_text: BigQuery is a fully managed data warehouse designed for large-scale analytics, offering a low-maintenance architecture that eliminates infrastructure management overhead. It supports standard SQL and cost-effective querying of massive datasets (10+ TBs) with built-in caching mechanisms for repeated queries. In contrast, Cloud SQL and self-managed MySQL are transactional databases not optimized for this volume of analytical workloads, while Cloud Spanner is primarily for low-latency global transactions rather than bulk analytics.

choices.text: Use Cloud SQL, but first organize the data into tables. Use JOIN in queries to retrieve data.
Use BigQuery as a data warehouse. Set output destinations for caching large queries.
Use a MySQL cluster installed on a Compute Engine managed instance group for scalability.
Use Cloud Spanner to replicate the data across regions. Normalize the data in a series of tables.
